text: DIFOT: delivery in full, on time.
A line passes only if the full quantity arrives by the agreed date. Late or short? It fails.
Lines in full and on time ÷ lines due × 100.
The trap: never multiply on-time by in-full. Lines failing both count twice.
Example: count by whole order, and the same month drops to 75%.
So agree five rules first: unit, date, ship or receipt, limits and splits.
Then give every failed line a cause. Fix the biggest first.
